abstract: Let $F=\F_{2^n}$ and let \[ \mathcal T_1=\{t\in F:\Tr_{F/\F_2}(t)=1\}. \] For an integer $u=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}u_i2^i$ of even binary weight, put \[ L_u(X)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}u_iX^{2^i}, \qquad L_{1,u}(t)=t+L_u(t^{-1}). \] Hollmann and Xiang conjectured that $L_{1,u}$ permutes $\mathcal T_1$ if and only if $u\in\{0,3,6,10\}$. We prove the necessity by a moment method; the sufficiency is their Theorem~4.1. The quadratic moment yields a cyclic autocorrelation identity, while the cubic moment gives a two-variable group-algebra identity. An elimination argument reduces the coefficient word to a monomial or a complementary monomial, and explicit cubic and quartic moments complete the classification. We also prove Hollmann and Xiang's Conjecture~4.5. Namely, if $n>3$ and \[ L_{c,d}(x)=L_c(x)+L_d(x^{-1}) \] is a Kloosterman polynomial on $\F_{2^n}$, then its positive linearized part $L_c$ is injective on both trace fibers. This second result follows from relative quadratic and cubic moment identities and a spectral-zero rigidity argument. Consequently every Kloosterman polynomial is obtained by composing one of $L_{1,0},L_{1,3},L_{1,6},L_{1,10}$ with a linearized map that is injective on both trace fibers.
hook: A conjecture on finite-field Kloosterman polynomials is proved: only four base cases exist.
summary: The paper proves both Hollmann and Xiang conjectures, showing that only four simple maps permute the trace-one elements of a binary finite field. Every Kloosterman polynomial then comes from one of those four composed with a suitable linear map. The proof uses moment identities and is a preprint that experts still need to check.
title: A Moment Proof of the Hollman-Xiang Conjectures on Kloosterman Polynomials
